scientific.integrity: Both rank-one factor states are solved exactly on a constant biregular support. Update clipping cancels the first temporal factor, reducing the remaining CAME dynamics to scalar EMA recurrences on a fixed support.
limitations: Biregular fixed support and source clipping threshold one.
Exact first-stage formula uses zero first regularizer.
No claim about stochastic training convergence.

title: CAME's confidence stage has an exact stationary gain law
